css-gradient-generator.workedExample:
The default gradient is:
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4f46e5 0%, #ec4899 100%);
135deg points diagonally from top-left to bottom-right.
The first stop #4f46e5 (indigo) covers the 0% position, the second stop #ec4899 (pink) covers 100%, and the browser blends smoothly between them.
Add a middle stop like #7c3aed 50% to deepen the transition.
